svg.text: Human First AI — typography
Plus Jakarta Sans carries the brand. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries anything anyone has to read for more than a sentence.
DISPLAY
54px / 1.08 / -0.03em / 800 / Plus Jakarta Sans
The future belongs to all of us.
Posters, campaign headers, the one line on a slide — Two lines maximum. Balance the wraps by hand. Never set in capitals.
HEADLINE
34px / 1.2 / -0.02em / 700 / Plus Jakarta Sans
Make AI feel like an open door, not a locked lab.
Section titles, booklet covers, slide openers — Deep Ink. Optical kerning on. Leave at least 32px of air above it.
TITLE
27px / 1.3 / -0.015em / 600 / Plus Jakarta Sans
What will I actually learn on Saturday?
Card titles, question headings, workshop agenda items — Use sentence case. A title that needs a colon is usually two titles.
SUBHEAD
21px / 1.45 / -0.01em / 500 / Plus Jakarta Sans
Free workshops in your neighbourhood, taught in your language.
Standfirsts, key takeaways, pull quotes — One sentence. If it runs past two lines it belongs in body copy.
BODY
17px / 1.65 / 0 / 400 / Atkinson Hyperlegible
Artificial intelligence should be as ordinary and dependable as electricity. You do not need a computer science degree to use it to run a
market stall, protect a crop from drought, or help a child with homework.
Curriculum, handouts, articles, letters — Atkinson Hyperlegible. 60–70 characters a line. Never justify. Never below 17px on screen or 11pt in print.
SMALL
15px / 1.6 / 0 / 400 / Atkinson Hyperlegible
Bring a friend. We provide the tablets, the notebooks and the tea.
Form help text, footnotes, table cells — The smallest size any sentence may be set in.
CAPTION
14px / 1.45 / 0.01em / 600 / Plus Jakarta Sans
Kibera Community Centre · Nairobi Chapter · 14 March 2026
Photo credits, timestamps, table headers, chapter tags — Separate with middots. Never put it in a pill. Never go below 14px — v1 allowed 13px, which fails for low-vision readers.
